description: v6 draw schedules across UTC date, month, year, leap-day and UK clock-change boundaries, for tags drand-quicknet+metoffice-landobs-v1 (landobs) and drand-quicknet+elexon-freq-v1 (freq). Expected values come from an independent reference, not from core. All times UTC, whole seconds, RFC 3339 with Z.

landobs.weather_time: latest whole UTC hour h with h + W + 60s <= draw_at, W = 1800s

landobs_w30_not_w40.note: W = 30 gives weather_time 20:00; W = 40 would give 19:00
